name: Markov chat
description:
Learns how your server talks from the channels you choose and mixes those messages into new sentences.
Other functions (like Voice chat) use it as their source of things to say; it can also chime in on its own.

settings.label: Channels to learn from
settings.help: OzBot reads new messages here. Nothing outside these channels is stored.

settings.label: Chain length
settings.help: How many words it looks back. 1 = wild nonsense, 2 = balanced, 3 = close to real messages (needs lots of chat).

settings.label: Allow exact copies
settings.help: Off = never repeat someone's message word for word.

settings.label: Messages to keep
settings.help: Oldest are forgotten first. 20,000 is about 3 MB.

settings.label: Reply when @mentioned
settings.help: In the learning channels. If the message has words, it tries to talk about one of them.

settings.label: Random reply chance (%)
settings.help: Chance of chiming in after any message in the learning channels. 0 = never.
